candidates.name: Hepatocellular carcinoma
support_spans: Liver biopsy showed islands of neoplastic cells with eosinophilic cytoplasm
Ultrasound: Echogenic liver parenchyma with fatty infiltration, single hypoechoic lesion measuring 11 × 10 × 7 mm
candidates.why: The patient's liver biopsy and imaging studies suggest a liver tumor, and the presence of neoplastic cells with eosinophilic cytoplasm is consistent with hepatocellular carcinoma.

candidates.name: Metastatic melanoma
support_spans: Immunostaining results: Positive for: human melanoma black-45, smooth muscle actin, and melanoma antigen recognized by T cells 1 (melan-A)
candidates.why: The positive immunostaining results for melanoma markers suggest that the liver lesion may be a metastasis from a melanoma.

candidates.name: Liver metastasis
support_spans: Ultrasound: Echogenic liver parenchyma with fatty infiltration, single hypoechoic lesion measuring 11 × 10 × 7 mm
MRI: 1-cm subcapsular enhancing lesion
candidates.why: The presence of a single hypoechoic lesion on ultrasound and a subcapsular enhancing lesion on MRI suggests a metastatic lesion in the liver.

candidates.name: Liver metastasis of other origin

candidates.why: The presence of a hypoechoic lesion in the liver, as seen on ultrasound, could indicate a metastasis from another primary cancer site.

candidates.name: Hepatocellular carcinoma

contradict_spans: Immunostaining results: - Negative for: hepatocyte paraffin 1, human arginase 1
